dedupe_keys.name: cmip6 based mosartwmpy simulations of inflow storage and release for conus multi use reservoirs

description: This dataset holds simulated daily inflow, release and storage for 1,861 powered and non-powered reservoirs in the contiguous United States listed in GRanD, for a 1980-2019 baseline and the 2020-2059 near-term future under the SSP5-8.5 scenario. Six CMIP6 climate models were downscaled statistically (DBCCA) and dynamically (RegCM) against Daymet and Livneh observations, run through the VIC and PRMS hydrological models, and routed with mosartwmpy, the Python version of the MOSART-WM water management model. Pacific Northwest National Laboratory produced it for the DOE Water Power Technologies Office's SECURE Water Act Section 9505 assessment and published it on Zenodo as Parquet files of about 0.6 to 0.85 GB per ensemble member, available as a free download under CC BY 4.0 (June 2025). Coverage is national. Caveats: the flows are model output, not observations, and only one high-emission scenario is covered. Simulation uses: climate stress tests of reservoir storage and release for water supply and hydropower capacity planning and climate adaptation. Related records: GRanD (data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database) and HydroConDams (data-hydrocondams-hydrologically-consistent-dams).
